messages:
anne: quick check — i'm about to rename a few runtime panels to be less ambiguous. need a quick consensus on TTFT / tok/s / p95 defs before i do that. is TTFT the client-observed first-byte (includes network) or the server first-token-emitted (gateway)? @jared @mike

jared: server-first-token-emitted (the one we track in runtime) is what we use for perf regressions. client-observed is useful for e2e but noisy. so in the runtime dashboard show "TTFT (server)" and note in tooltip how to correlate with client metrics.

mike: +1. for tok/s we should be explicit about measurement window — we currently compute tokens/sec over the 1m rolling window from the inference host. maybe call it "tok/s (host, 1m)".

anne: cool. for p95 latency do we include decoding time + batching latency? or only model forward time?

jared: p95 should be end-to-end inside the runtime process: batching + model forward + decode overhead (so it reflects what customers see from the inference container). exclude network/gateway. we'll add a separate "edge p95" later.

sarah: from oncall perspective — we need clear alert ownership and thresholds. can we pick sensible defaults and owners? suggestion: p95 >= 1.2s for small models, >= 3s for large models — trigger warning at 80% of that. thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: those thresholds sound OK as a starting point. i'll own a PR to add alerts to the dashboard. plan: add two alerts per model-class (warning/critical) and include a runbook link.

anne: awesome. mike — can you also add a short description field on the panel describing the exact metric formula so future folks don't guess? e.g. `TTFT = time_from_request_received_to_first_token_emitted_in_runtime_ms`

mike: will do. i'll drop the prometheus/explorer queries in the PR. example draft query for runtime prometheus:```sum by(model) (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))```will label that as "runtime p95 (incl batching+decode)"

jared: small note: use a 5m window for stability but keep a 1m panel for quick reaction. two panels is fine.

sarah: onboarding note: include ownership tags on each panel (e.g., owner:mike, owner:runtime) so alerts route properly.

anne: sounds like a plan. action items: mike -> PR to add panel descriptions + alerts + runbook link; jared -> add tooltip text about server vs client TTFT correlation; anne -> rename panels and update legends. I'll wait 24h for objections before renaming.

mike: pinged. ETA for PR: EOD tomorrow.

jared: i'll add the tooltip text today.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: production alerting config updated for runtime namespace (change set id: cs-2026-45)

anne: thanks all :thumbsup: i'll hold off renames until we have mike's PR and jared's tooltip text. if anyone has a strong objection speak up in next 24h.
sarah: no objections from oncall.

anne: closing loop — will rename after PR merges and will send a follow-up note in #eng-runtime."
